title: Debug: The Pipeline That Reads the Log Twice
prompt:
`Summarize` over a counting source calls Count() and then Max() on the SAME lazy source — two full reads. Fix it so the source is read exactly once and the summary stays "count=<n>;max=<m>".

```csharp
static string Summarize(IEnumerable<int> source);   // "count=6;max=42"
```

tests.name: one read, same summary
tests.hint: var data = source.ToList(); — count and max from the materialized list.

tests.name: empty and single
tests.hint: Empty list: max 0 by convention — no exceptions.
